notes.title: UPDATE 0.2.45 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]As you can probably see from the big difference in version numbers, since the last public update, we have been rather busy in the background with optimizing and testing.   

And yep, new stuff coming out next week already, unless something dramatic happens, so fingers crossed. Best part? It's stuff from before the 0.3 update, so all of it will be surprises ;)      

 Things we are still looking into[/p][list][*][p]Small mouse movements not registering[/p][/*][*][p]Some extra fixes for the larger slides[/p][/*][*][p]A new system that allows visitors to teleport if they get stuck. This is actually ready and being tested, and it will be an option you can enable if you want (more details on the next update)

[/p][/*][/list][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Fixes on some decorations, mainly planters, at the level of textures[/p][/*][*][p]Bug solved where the staff would try to build attractions that were not placed [/p][/*][*][p]Ticket staff energy depletion has been fixed to actually reflect on their stats (aka they will get less tired so fast)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix on the staff hiring in non-English languages where the text could get cut[/p][/*][*][p]Building is no longer possible at the street level on the right side of the park[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Several improvements overall that should help with lag in many cases[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements in the Chinese translation in some areas of the game[/p][/*][*][p]New graffiti available[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the system on the tablet to allow park renaming[/p][/*][*][p]Unique visitors' appearance chance adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]A new unique visitor has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimisation in painting, both in looks and in memory use[/p][/*][*][p]Improved interactions with trash[/p][/*][*][p]Improved sorting system when allocating staff[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the look of some surfaces when on medium quality[/p][/*][*][p]Taser on the pool now, ragdolls everyone in the water[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements on the liferings obtained from different buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Some of the staff stats were improved[/p][/*][*][p]Improved slide segment collisions[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements on the daily report info [/p][/*][*][p]Improvements for lemonade vending[/p][/*][*][p]Improved colliders for the diving boards[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements for the inflatable slides[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements on collisions when the player uses slides or passes under slides[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]
NEW FEATURES[/h3][list][*][p]Extra easter egg perma graffiti [/p][/*][*][p]New emojis being used in the visitors emotes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We are already working on not only fixing some issues mentioned by you all, but also adding new features. So stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, and remember, if you have an idea, feedback, or bug you want to share, feel free to use our Steam community hub or Discord. We are always there to listen and chat with you.  [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3293260/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3293260/discussions/[/url]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2.37 - Patch Notes
notes.content:

You will also notice news at the visitor's looks level

[/p][list][*][p]Twitch integration (we think we already solved it and are testing it before pushing it to you guys as well)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Some new dumpsters might be on the way ;)[/p][/*][*][p]Working on some new models for players and staff[/p][/*][*][p]Other performance issues you mentioned
[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some screen resolutions would not show up under some conditions[/p][/*][*][p]4-star Pool fix on the water seams[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a translation related to getting a reward for taking out trash[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix that would hire the same employee twice under certain conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a looping animation for cleaner[/p][/*][*][p]UI fix for volume controls[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Improvements in game performance at different levels that should solve many of the lag and crash issues some players had[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs now look physically more according to their ticket type (teen, adult, senior)[/p][/*][*][p]Idle animations added for male and female guests[/p][/*][*][p]Walking animation for male and female guests[/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations in the NPCs' AI [/p][/*][*][p]Improvements in some slide surfaces[/p][/*][*][p]Made it impossible to add an item too close to the entrance so that they could get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Added localized hints if a trash bin is full[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some checks of stock on restocking[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement in staff cleaning graffiti [/p][/*][*][p]Animation added for graffiti vandals[/p][/*][*][p]The interaction system has been improved to avoid cases where it could start even in cases where they should not be possible[/p][/*][*][p]Added $ symbol when the visitor asks for a ticket, and the price is shown[/p][/*][*][p]Added recovery time stat to the hiring menu (it already was there, now it is just shown)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed thoughts generated based on decoration levels[/p][/*][*][p]UI adjustments to the daily report[/p][/*][*][p]New section added to the daily report for decoration tips[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2.32 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]New language support for Ukrainian and an issue with staff animations are some of the biggest changes this time.

We also made some improvements for the achievement hunters with more people queuing for the ticket machines and cleaning poop in pools, counting in more ways.


We are currently working on the following issues and trying to get them sorted as soon as possible
[/p][list][*][p]Lag issues in some players' games[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reducing the number of injuries caused by slides[/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Lifeguard hiring levels have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with decorations' red outline.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, in lower graphic settings, parts of the park looked a different color even with the same paint.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where staff would not perform their job due to the animations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Lifeguard chair now allows you to get medikit and liferings out of it. notes.title: UPDATE 0.2.30 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Yep, the mirror has been replaced by a dresser. Why, you ask? Well we are using the mirror for something else, that will be added very soon.   

Just a quick heads up, we have seen the issues some of you are having with lag, so we are fixing it as well. The dev team is 5 people, so while one of us works on something like an improvement, another is working on fixing reported bugs. We appreciate your patience, and we promise we will have it sorted as soon as we can.   

Ok, let's see what we changed since the weekend.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]NPCs are no longer stuck in  swimming if you move the pool where they were.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs don't get stuck if you destroy the pool they were using.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where staff could get stuck on the destruction of items if they were interacting with them.[/p][/*][*][p]Diving boards from 0-2 stars can no longer be placed inside bushes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes on the builder/maintenance staff to avoid them getting stuck in some scenarios.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p] Twitcher integration now allows you to choose the gender of visitors or hires by adding m or f after the !visit or !hireme command[/p][/*][*][p]A status indicator in-game to show if the bot is connected to the game via Twitch channel[/p][/*][*][p]Added some extra info to help connections[/p][/*][*][p]Added new animations to staff restocking vending machines[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2.26 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Quite a lot to digest on this one, so let's just dig into it. [/p][p][/p][p]Major things for you guys is now you get a stronger save system (it even does 2 backups, not just 1) and some major buffs to staff.
Also, there is a new menu with some nice QOLs that we noticed you guys asking for (and even creating mods for it, so special thanks to the mod community for the extra inspiration to get us to create these.)

[/p][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Improvements in pathfinding for visitors and staff[/p][/*][*][p]"Wishlist now" button removed from main menu (yes, we all missed it for over a week)[/p][/*][*][p]Made it impossible to build anything on the street level (outside of the park)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would cause janitors to get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that in some situations could make visitors' clothes...well... disappear[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Major improvements (almost a rework to be honest) in the saving system to make it even more sturdy and less likely to corrupt[/p][/*][*][p]Added new instructions messages in case something is wrong with the save file[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the precision of staff[/p][/*][*][p]Made the efficiency % of staff more logical for their levels (which means they got buffed)[/p][/*][*][p]Raised the minimum % efficiency from 45 to 75 % for level 1 employees (max 100)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved messages in case of staff failing a task[/p][/*][*][p]Decoration points improved in many items[/p][/*][*][p]Many task list requirements were reworked and improved for the player[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hunger and thirst levels of visitors[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced prices of restocks[/p][/*][*][p]The ice-cream stand's price has been reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Increased probability of Smelly guests spawning [/p][/*][*][p]Changed "the bigger they are" achievement to be easier to obtain[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]
NEW FEATURES[/h3][list][*][p]New Accessibility menu, which allows players to disable ragdoll on double jump, disable running VFX, and less slipping on puddles for the player[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tarvis (the name of our studio CEO) as a possible employee (yes, you can boss them around now)[/p][/*][*][p]Working on Rich presence for Discord status (first version, but you can already show your friends what you are doing in-game via Discord status) Special mention to [b]QXRR[/b] since they beat us to it with their mod[/p][/*][/list][p]EXTRA NOTE - As we wrote this, we discovered some vials from the smart guy were spawning under the floor. The task mission is still possible, but we will patch this as soon as possible [/p][hr][/hr][p]We are already working on not only fixing some issues mentioned by you all, but also adding new features. notes.content:
[p]Good news for all the achievement hunters. They are all working as intended now. We are aware that restockers are still a bit broken, but we are working on them, and they should behave properly on the next update  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Lifeguards are fixed and save people from drowning again.[/p][/*][*][p]Ambulance drivers can now find their way to injured visitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Slides no longer injure visitors halfway[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some techs being available before they were researched[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements and their counters are all working as intended ( some just need images to be updated, which will happen soon)[/p][/*][*][p]Moving a broken item now also moves the broken warning above it[/p][/*][*][p]Soda-drunk visitors can now drown like other visitors[/p][/*][*][p]Staff now respawn in the changing room, so they appear in the park faster[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Added a system to make save game corruption harder to happen[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalancing the requirements for 5 stars[/p][/*][*][p]Fountains tech has been removed from the tech tree (we need to rework them a bit later on)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]
NEW FEATURES[/h3][list][*][p]Staff leaderboard 1st version is now available in the tool shed (you can check some basic stats of what your staff did during the day)
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We are already working on not only fixing some issues mentioned by you all, but also adding new features. So stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, and remember, if you have an idea, feedback, or bug you want to share, feel free to use our Steam community hub or Discord. We are always there to listen and chat with you.  [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3293260/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3293260/discussions/[/url]

[b]NOTICE[/b] -  We sometimes might release very small updates to solve 1 or 2 more urgent issues that appeared and not release a patch note for those immediately but add them to bigger update patch notes on following updates[/p]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2.17 - Patch Notes
notes.content:

NEW FEATURES[/h3][list][*][p]Screen resolution settings.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now interact with staff the same way you can with visitors.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We are already working on not only fixing some issues mentioned by you all, but also adding new features.
